items.html: And you already know that Netzach is included in the Hesed, which is the right line, and Hod is included in the Gevura, and therefore these NH are hinted at in the skull and the brain, in which are the HG of Atik, and they are hidden there, and from there they go out through that membrane, which is the Tifferet, and from there the NH go out in the aspect of hooks. And this is the secret of the hairs being called in the Tikkunim, page 102, side B, two hooks, as it said, "and every strand is the measure of the letter Vav." And it seems to me, by my life, that these hairs are the secret of the lower beard, upon the two testicles of Atik, for in this pattern the beard of ZA was made, in the NHY of AA; and see there.
